queries.text: Is the central object approximately round or spherical in outline?
Does the central object have a smooth, waxy-looking surface?
Is there a bright specular highlight indicating a curved, glossy surface?
Is the central object a fairly uniform, solid color across its surface?
Are thin branching veins visible across the surface of the object?
Is the object a flat, thin structure rather than a solid rounded body?
Does the object have a pointed tip or an elongated leaf-like outline?
Is a short stem or calyx visible where the object attaches to a branch?
Is the crop dominated by rough brown bark or woody branch texture?
Is a large portion of the crop plain open sky?
Is the crop dominated by bare soil, ground, or dead debris?
Is the crop blurry or out of focus so that no object is clearly identifiable?
Is the dominant object predominantly green?
Does the object appear to be a solid three-dimensional ball rather than a flat surface?
Is the object compact and roughly as wide as it is tall?
Is there smooth shading that curves around a rounded form?
Does the surface show a fine pebbled or dimpled rind texture?
Does the crop contain many small mixed elements rather than one clear object?
Is there one clearly dominant object centered in the crop?
Is a single central midrib line running along the object visible?
Is the surface matte and rough rather than smooth?
Is a large portion of the crop a flat, bright, washed-out background region?
